thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P0 -> high 5xx rate from inference-prod, alerting oncall (PD-2026-0342)
Alex: seeing ~12% 5xx for /v1/generate, started ~2026-03-15T10:11:30Z
Maria: on pager, jumping in. Any deploys around 10:05? @deploy-bot could you confirm?
deploy-bot: roll v2.3.7 -> prod at 2026-03-15T10:05:12Z (canary 20% then promote). Change: init-container runs as uid 1001 and readinessProbe now waits for /tmp/ready (5s initialDelay, period 10s)
Jordan: grabbing pods in inference namespace now
Devon: ```kubectl get pods -n inference-prod | grep model-deploy```
Devon: ```
NAME                                   READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
model-deploy-7f9c4b8c9-2kd8p           0/2     CrashLoopBackOff   14         12m
model-deploy-7f9c4b8c9-5xj2m           1/2     Running            0          8m
model-deploy-7f9c4b8c9-9pqrk           0/2     CrashLoopBackOff   11         9m
```
Jordan: looks like the init container is failing on several pods
Devon: kubectl logs model-deploy-7f9c4b8c9-2kd8p -c init-setup -n inference-prod
Devon: ```
2026-03-15T10:11:50Z ERROR init: failed to mount /mnt/config: permission denied
2026-03-15T10:11:50Z ERROR init: exiting with code 1
```
Alex: that matches the change in the manifest — init container mounts a config PVC and drops privileges. Could be mountmode or CSI change.
Maria: checking recent gitops commit: commit 3f7b8d changed PVC mode to ReadOnlyMany -> should be ReadWriteOnce. If it's mounted RW->RO, init failing to write /tmp/ready
Jordan: also seeing HPA thrash: `kubectl get hpa -n inference-prod` shows minReplicas: 5 for this deployment (we usually use min 1)
Devon: ```kubectl get hpa model-deploy -n inference-prod -o yaml | sed -n '1,120p'```
Devon: ```
minReplicas: 5
maxReplicas: 50
metrics: ...
```
Maria: PDB exists too: `disruptionBudget minAvailable: 3`. With HPA min 5 + PDB minAvailable 3 and node pressure we're failing scheduling for new pods; cluster is overloaded from canary expansion
Laura: customers on eu-west seeing 503 spikes, support routed ~20 tickets in last 10m. Potentially degraded but not full outage.
Alex: mitigation plan: 1) flip kill-switch flag to bypass new init behavior if possible; 2) if flag not available do immediate rollback to v2.3.6; 3) reduce HPA minReplicas to 1; 4) relax PDB to allow eviction; 5) monitor.
Jordan: quick check: feature flag `enable_new_init` exists but guard only in app start path, not in init container (init runs before app). So flag can't bypass init.
Devon: starting rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-deploy -n inference-prod --to-revision=3`
Devon: ```
deployment.apps/model-deploy "model-deploy" rolled back
```
deploy-bot: rollback initiated by Devon (manual) at 10:24 UTC; canary traffic throttled to 0% as part of rollback hook
Maria: while rollback runs, I'm patching HPA to minReplicas=1 to relieve scheduler pressure
Maria: ```kubectl patch hpa model-deploy -n inference-prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":1}}'```
Maria: patch applied
Jordan: PDB patch to allow evictions: `kubectl patch pdb model-deploy-pdb -n inference-prod -p '{"spec":{"minAvailable":1}}'`
Devon: PDB relaxed, scaling operations allowed
Devon: checking pods after rollback: `kubectl get pods -n inference-prod | grep model-deploy`
Devon: ```
NAME                                   READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
model-deploy-6a4b2d9c3-4h9pt          2/2     Running   0          2m
model-deploy-6a4b2d9c3-8xwq1          2/2     Running   0          2m
```
Alex: monitoring logs and SLO dashboards; error rate trending down from 12% -> 0.8% in 3 minutes
ops-bot: Incident annotated: root_cause_guess=init-container-mount-perms; remediation=rollback and hpa/pdb patches; customers_impacted=eu-west ~20 tickets; duration=~19m so far
Laura: coordinating customer comms. Notifying critical accounts and creating post-incident followup.
Maria: recommending postmortem actions: revert incorrect PVC mode change in gitops, add e2e check for init container mounts, add a preflight HPA/pdb validation before canary promotion, and make init-container changes behind a deploy-time toggle rather than immediate manifest change.
Jordan: also suggest making init less privileged or ensure it's resilient to RO mounts (create /tmp in emptyDir) so it doesn't write to PVC during init step.
Devon: handoff to next oncall @Jordan in 30m, but will keep monitoring for 15m.
Jordan: acknowledged, I'll watch dashboards and traces.
incident-bot: Incident PD-2026-0342: status -> mitigated; paging stopped at 10:33 UTC; incident owner: Devon; notes: rollback to v2.3.6 + HPA/PDB adjustments resolved immediate customer impact.
Laura: summary for postmortem: customers: eu-west latency/503s for ~19 minutes, root cause: bad manifest change to PVC mountmode + aggressive HPA minReplicas; mitigation: rollback + HPA/PDB patch; next steps assigned in followup doc. :white_check_mark:
Alex: moving to postmortem doc and tagging infra, platform, and eng-qa teams for remediation tasks.
Maria: closing the incident channel, will reopen if errors climb again. :lock_with_ink_pen:
